change: macOS 27.2 only lets virtual HID devices match GameController personalities marked GCIOMatchVirtual; the Xbox 360 identity (045E:028E) is not, so games such as WoW saw no controller. The virtual pad now presents as an Xbox Series X|S Bluetooth controller (045E:0B13) with that controller's 17-byte report.
verification: Release build on macOS 27.2: phone auto-reconnected with same receiver identity; GameController lists it as an extended Xbox gamepad. Pre-release local build of the same gamepad code moved a WoW Forever character from the iPhone's left stick; WoW logged 'GamePad 1 connected: Xbox Series X Controller'. Not tested on macOS 15/26.
